entities.summary: Javon DeAndre Hargrave is an American professional football defensive tackle for the Green Bay Packers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the South Carolina State Bulldogs and he was selected by the Pittsburgh Steelers in the third round of the 2016 NFL draft.
